sources.title: Upgrade to Flask 3 · Issue #1801 · tiny-pilot/tinypilot · GitHub

entries.title: json.JSONEncoder and json.JSONDecoder removed (breaking)
entries.migration: flask.json.JSONEncoder -> app.json.provider or custom JSONProvider; remove direct use of flask.json.JSONEncoder/JSONDecoder
entries.quote: `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` attributes on app and blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are removed.

entries.title: json.htmlsafe_dumps and json.htmlsafe_dump removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use Jinja's built-in safe dumping or markupsafe directly; remove calls to flask.json.htmlsafe_dumps/htmlsafe_dump
entries.quote: The `json.htmlsafe_dumps` and `htmlsafe_dump` functions are removed.

entries.title: RequestContext.g property removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use `g` directly or `AppContext.g` instead of RequestContext.g
entries.quote: The `RequestContext.g` property returning `AppContext.g` is removed.

entries.title: send_file/from_directory parameter renames (breaking)
entries.migration: attachment_filename -> download_name; cache_timeout -> max_age; add_etags -> etag; filename -> path in send_from_directory; update all call sites
entries.quote: Old names for some `send_file` parameters have been removed. `download_name` replaces `attachment_filename`, `max_age` replaces `cache_timeout`, and `etag` replaces `add_etags`. Additionally, `path` replaces `filename` in `send_from_directory`.

entries.title: config.from_json replaced by from_file (breaking)
entries.migration: config.from_json -> config.from_file(name, load=json.load)
entries.quote: `config.from_json` is replaced by `config.from_file(name,load=json.load)`.

entries.title: import escape/Markup from flask deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Import escape and Markup directly from markupsafe instead of flask; update all import statements
entries.quote: Importing `escape` and `Markup` from `flask` is deprecated. Import them directly from `markupsafe` instead.

entries.title: json_encoder and json_decoder attributes on app/blueprint deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Use app.json provider interface to customize JSON behavior; stop setting json_encoder/json_decoder directly
entries.quote: Setting custom `json_encoder` and `json_decoder` classes on the app or a blueprint, and the corresponding `json.JSONEncoder` and `JSONDecoder` classes, are deprecated.

entries.title: json_encoder/access raises deprecation warning (deprecation)
entries.migration: Stop setting/accessing json_encoder/json_decoder to avoid warnings
entries.quote: Setting or accessing `json_encoder` or `json_decoder` raises a deprecation warning.

entries.title: session marked accessed for key-only ops (behavior)
entries.migration: Code using `in` or `len` on session will now mark it as accessed; may affect session persistence behavior
entries.quote: The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as `in` and `len`.

entries.title: stream_with_context async view fix (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; bug fix for async views
entries.quote: `stream_with_context` does not fail inside async views.

entries.title: session state correct with follow_redirects (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; bug fix for test client
entries.quote: When using `follow_redirects` in the test client, the final state of `session` is correct.

entries.title: send_file bytes IO type hint relaxed (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; type hint relaxation
entries.quote: Relax type hint for passing bytes IO to `send_file`.

entries.title: Vary: Cookie header set on session access (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; header will be set automatically
entries.quote: Set `Vary: Cookie` header when the session is accessed, modified, or refreshed.

entries.title: app.before_first_request and bp.before_app_first_request removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Replace with startup code executed during app creation; remove @app.before_first_request / @bp.before_app_first_request decorators
entries.quote: The `app.before_first_request` and `bp.before_app_first_request` decorators are removed.

entries.title: app.session_cookie_name, send_file_max_age_default, use_x_sendfile, propagate_exceptions, templates_auto_reload removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use config keys directly (e.g., SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, SEND_FILE_MAX_AGE_DEFAULT) instead of app.* attributes
entries.quote: The `session_cookie_name`, `send_file_max_age_default`, `use_x_sendfile`, `propagate_exceptions`, and `templates_auto_reload` properties on `app` are removed.

entries.title: FLASK_ENV and ENV config/app.env removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Control debug mode directly via --debug or app.run(debug=True); remove references to FLASK_ENV and app.env
entries.quote: The `FLASK_ENV` environment variable, `ENV` config key, and `app.env` property are removed.

entries.title: app._app_ctx_stack and _request_ctx_stack top removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Store data on `g` instead using a unique prefix; stop using _app_ctx_stack.top and _request_ctx_stack.top
entries.quote: Extension maintainers, be aware that `_app_ctx_stack.top` and `_request_ctx_stack.top` are deprecated. Store data on `g` instead using a unique prefix, like `g._extension_name_attr`.

entries.title: safe_join removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use werkzeug.utils.safe_join instead of flask.safe_join
entries.quote: `safe_join` is removed, use `werkzeug.utils.safe_join` instead.

entries.title: total_seconds removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use timedelta.total_seconds instead of flask.total_seconds
entries.quote: `total_seconds` is removed, use `timedelta.total_seconds` instead.

entries.title: same blueprint name registration restriction (breaking)
entries.migration: Use `name=` when registering blueprints to specify unique names
entries.quote: The same blueprint cannot be registered with the same name. Use `name=` when registering to specify a unique name.

entries.title: test client as_tuple removed (breaking)
entries.migration: Use response.request.environ instead of test client as_tuple
entries.quote: The test client’s `as_tuple` parameter is removed. Use `response.request.environ` instead.

entries.title: CLI context variable management (breaking)
entries.migration: No direct API change for app code; extension maintainers should migrate from LocalStack to Python context vars
entries.quote: The app and request contexts are managed using Python context vars directly rather than Werkzeug’s LocalStack.

entries.title: app.env deprecated then removed (deprecation->breaking)
entries.migration: Control debug mode directly; remove references to app.env
entries.quote: The `FLASK_ENV` environment variable and `app.env` attribute are deprecated, removing the distinction between development and debug mode.

entries.title: app.got_first_request deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Remove usage of app.got_first_request; no direct replacement needed
entries.quote: The `app.got_first_request` property is deprecated.

entries.title: locked_cached_property deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Use a lock inside the decorated function if locking is needed; remove @locked_cached_property
entries.quote: The `locked_cached_property` decorator is deprecated. Use a lock inside the decorated function if locking is needed.

entries.title: signals_available deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Remove checks for signals_available; signals are always available
entries.quote: The `signals_available` attribute is deprecated. Signals are always available.

entries.title: app.before_first_request deprecated (deprecation)
entries.migration: Run setup code when creating the application instead; remove @app.before_first_request
entries.quote: before_first_request is deprecated. Run setup code when creating the application instead.

entries.title: app.env default changed to production (deprecation)
entries.migration: No code change needed; attribute remains deprecated
entries.quote: Fix the default value for `app.env` to be `"production"`. This attribute remains deprecated.

entries.title: Python 3.6/3.7/3.8 support dropped (behavior)
entries.migration: Ensure code targets Python 3.9+; remove any 3.6/3.7/3.8 compatibility shims
entries.quote: Drop support for Python 3.6. [2.1.0]; Drop support for Python 3.7. [2.3.0]; Drop support for Python 3.8. [3.0.0]

entries.title: Werkzeug >= 3.1 minimum (dependency/behavior)
entries.migration: Upgrade Werkzeug to >= 3.1; API changes in Werkzeug may affect Flask code
entries.quote: Update minimum dependency versions to latest feature releases. Werkzeug >= 3.1, ItsDangerous >= 2.2, Blinker >= 1.9.

entries.title: Python 3.12 compatibility (behavior)
entries.migration: No code change needed; compatibility update
entries.quote: Python 3.12 compatibility.

entries.title: SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED added (feature)
entries.migration: Opt-in via config; no code change required unless using partitioned cookies
entries.quote: Add support for the `Partitioned` cookie attribute (CHIPS), with the `SESSION_COOKIE_PARTITIONED` config.

entries.title: SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS added (feature)
entries.migration: Configure via app.config["SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS"] = [old_keys]; extensions need to add support
entries.quote: Support key rotation with the `SECRET_KEY_FALLBACKS` config, a list of old secret keys that can still be used for unsigning.

entries.title: TRUSTED_HOSTS config added (feature)
entries.migration: Set via app.config["TRUSTED_HOSTS"]; checked during routing
entries.quote: `Request.trusted_hosts` is checked during routing, and can be set through the `TRUSTED_HOSTS` config.

entries.title: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH per-request customization (feature)
entries.migration: Can now set per-request; added MAX_FORM_MEMORY_SIZE and MAX_FORM_PARTS config
entries.quote: `Request.max_content_length` can be customized per-request instead of only through the `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` config.

entries.title: open_resource encoding parameter (feature)
entries.migration: New encoding parameter defaults to utf-8; no code change needed unless custom encoding was used
entries.quote: Flask.open_resource/Blueprint.open_resource take an `encoding` parameter to use when opening in text mode. It defaults to `utf-8`.

entries.title: Config.from_prefixed_env added (feature)
entries.migration: New method to load config from env vars with FLASK_ prefix; optional adoption
entries.quote: Add `Config.from_prefixed_env()` to load config values from environment variables that start with `FLASK_` or another prefix.

entries.title: Config.from_file text parameter (feature)
entries.migration: Optional text=False for binary parsing; optional adoption
entries.quote: config.from_file can use `text=False` to indicate that the parser wants a binary file instead.

payload.analysis: The upgrade to Flask 3.1.3 pulled in Werkzeug ≥ 3.1, which removed `url_quote` from `werkzeug.urls`. The application's `notes/__init__.py` imports `url_quote` from that location, causing an ImportError at test-collection time. The rest of the code already uses the modern Flask 3.x APIs: `app.json.provider` for custom JSON encoding (replacing the removed `json_encoder`/`json_decoder`), `escape` imported from `markupsafe` (per deprecation migration), and no other deprecated symbols. The only required change is migrating the `url_quote` import to its standard-library replacement `urllib.parse.quote`, which provides equivalent URL-quoting behaviour for the single call site that generates a slug.

edits.justification: Replace the removed `werkzeug.urls.url_quote` import with `urllib.parse.quote` (the standard-library equivalent) so the module imports cleanly on Werkzeug ≥ 3.1; all other Flask 3.x migrations (JSON provider, markupsafe import) were already correct.
edits.evidence_url: https://werkzeug.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/changes (Werkzeug 3.x removed top-level `url_quote`; migration is to use direct imports or stdlib `urllib.parse.quote`)
